Supreme Court gives actor Rajpal Yadav final chance in cheque bounce cases

The Supreme Court has granted actor Rajpal Yadav a final opportunity to deposit a sum of money in connection with cheque bounce cases. The court indicated it was giving him a "last opportunity" and expressed hope that he was not "acting here." The specific amounts mentioned in the coverage vary, with one report stating Rs 5 crore and another Rs 2 crore. The cases stem from cheque bounce allegations.
